summary: First-finish smoke: Backend (auth, actors, movies CRUD, search, filter, trending, recent, genres, reviews, watchlist, admin RBAC, unauth) all pass. Frontend (home hero+trending+recent, admin login, admin create actor+movie, movie appears on home+browse, hero search to /browse, movie detail page) all render correctly. Minor: MovieDetail data-testids (movie-title, cast-section) not on rendered nodes; cast-actor-0 in admin form is a Radix Select (BUTTON) — needs different interaction than <select>.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin returns admin role, cookies set
POST/GET/GET-by-id /api/actors (admin) works; actor has movies[] populated
POST/GET /api/movies works; cast enriched with actor {id,name,photo_url}
GET /api/movies?q=dark and q=Bale (actor name) both return matching movie
POST /api/movies/{id}/reviews upserts; GET reviews returns list; avg_rating updated to 9.0
Admin-only endpoints reject non-admin (403) and unauth (401)
Home page: hero-search-input, trending-section, recent-section render
Admin login flow lands on home with admin nav shown
Admin can create Actor and Movie; new movie appears on Home and Browse
Hero search navigates to /browse?q=... and filters correctly (Query pill visible)
Clicking movie card opens /movie/:id showing title, genres, release, synopsis, Cast & Crew section, Add to Watchlist

failed.issue: data-testid attributes 'movie-title' and 'cast-section' are not present on rendered DOM (page renders content correctly though).
failed.evidence: await page.query_selector('[data-testid="movie-title"]') returns None on /movie/{id}, but the H1 title 'UI MOVIE 1790622895' and 'Cast & Crew' section are visually rendered.

failed.issue: data-testid='cast-actor-0' is a Radix Select BUTTON, not a native <select>, so admin form couldn't link an actor via standard select_option; movie was still created but with empty cast.
failed.evidence: cast-actor-0 tag: BUTTON; movie created but no cast linked in that flow.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='movie-title' to the H1 and data-testid='cast-section' to the Cast & Crew wrapper in MovieDetail.jsx for reliable e2e selection.
Optional: expose data-testid on Radix Select value/trigger, or document that cast-actor-0 requires click+option-click flow.
